definitions.explanation: a gift given to celebrate someone's graduation

examples.japanese: {卒業|そつぎょう}{祝|いわ}い⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{時計|とけい}→時計：00677_tokei⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦もらった→もらう：00520_morau⟧。
examples.english: I received a watch as a graduation gift.

examples.japanese: ⟦{姪|めい}→姪：03899_mei⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{卒業|そつぎょう}{祝|いわ}い⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{何|なに}→何：00498_nani⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{贈|おく}る→贈る：09862_okuru⟧⟦か→か：09473_ka⟧⟦{相談|そうだん}した→相談する：01845_soudansuru⟧。
examples.english: I discussed what to give my niece for her graduation gift.

examples.japanese: {大学|だいがく}{卒業|そつぎょう}{祝|いわ}い⟦として→として：06802_toshite⟧⟦{旅行券|りょこうけん}→旅行券：28001_ryokouken⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦プレゼント→プレゼント：01791_purezento⟧⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: I gave a travel voucher as a university graduation celebration gift.

notes:
TIMING:
{卒業|そつぎょう}{祝|いわ}い is typically given around March when most Japanese schools hold graduation ceremonies.

COMMON GIFTS:
- ⟦{現金|げんきん}→現金：02716_genkin⟧ - cash
- ⟦{商品券|しょうひんけん}→商品券：22121_shouhinken⟧ - gift certificates
- ⟦ビジネス→ビジネス：11162_bijinesu⟧⟦{用品|ようひん}→用品：13526_youhin⟧ - business accessories (pen, card case)
- ⟦{腕時計|うでどけい}→腕時計：04538_udedokei⟧ - wristwatch

RELATED OCCASIONS:
{卒業|そつぎょう}{祝|いわ}い is often combined with ⟦{入学|にゅうがく}{祝|いわ}い→入学祝い：08661_nyuugakuiwai⟧ (school entrance gift) or ⟦{就職|しゅうしょく}{祝|いわ}い→就職祝い：08664_shuushokuiwai⟧ (job celebration gift) when these events occur around the same time.
